evals.prompt: Set up a new panel guide folder from the panel-twin skill at <scratch>/job-test/Assembly Guide V1.0, build it, run the audit, and tell me the numbers.
evals.expected_output: A new folder made with scripts/new_panel.mjs that contains the engine, data and PANEL-CHECKLIST.md but not the example's README/START HERE. 'node build.mjs' writes the HTML (about 14 MB). scripts/audit_headless.mjs --max-kinks 2 prints AUDIT: PASS with through 0, across 0, shared 0, behind 0, nothing unresolved, and the two known tight bends named (W62, CBL-IOL-16); without --max-kinks it prints AUDIT: FAIL because of those two bends, and the reply says so rather than hiding it. The reply states the folder, the audit numbers as printed, and that the folder is still the VFD 200 guide until its data is replaced.

evals.prompt: In the VFD 200 guide, IO1's VAC-VDC 2 terminal has no supply. Add a 16 AWG wire for it from PDB2 OUT8 on the 24 V sheet, as a new version, and make sure nothing else broke.
evals.expected_output: A new version folder made with scripts/new_version.mjs (the earlier one untouched, VERSION 16.0). The wire added in ADDED in build.mjs, not in data/wirelist.json: no invented wire number or potential number, awg 16, from PDB2 OUT8 to IO1 VAC-VDC 2, sheet 7, step w24, added: true, a note beginning NOT ON THE DRAWINGS; a design issue and a task or flag on the step. Appended last so no existing segment moves. Built; audit run on the last version and the new one; scripts/diff_routes.mjs shows 195 identical, 0 changed, 1 new; the new wire is drawn, nothing unresolved, through/across/shared/behind 0. Pictures of IO1 and PDB2 taken with scripts/shot.mjs and looked at. Handover documents updated. The reply says whether it is saved, that the wire is not on the drawings and needs engineering to add and number it, gives the audit numbers, and says what was not checked.

evals.prompt: Can you check sheet 4 of Draft rev20.pdf against the wire list in the VFD 200 guide and tell me if anything is missing?
evals.expected_output: The PDF is found to have no text layer (sheet_tiles.py --text reports 0) and is read as image tiles. Sheet 4's conductors are compared with the sheet-4 entries. The report lists only differences, each checked on the sheet, with counts (45 conductors drawn; the incoming feeder to Q1 1L1/3L2/5L3 and ground to GB1 terminal 1 are drawn dashed and are handled in build.mjs as FEEDERS rather than in wirelist.json). It says what was not covered (other sheets).

evals.prompt: The transformer in the guide looks backwards to me compared with the one on the bench. Here's a photo.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a question to settle from the photo and the maker's document, not a request to flip the model on say-so. Looks at the device from several sides (shot.mjs or model_viewer), compares features that face only one way with the photo, states what it found, fixes model_fit.mjs / the PROC builder if wrong, rebuilds, audits, shows a before and after picture, and records it in REVISIONS.md in a new version folder.

evals.prompt: We have a new job, a small PLC panel: drawing set PDF, BOM spreadsheet, no photos yet. Make the panel twin.
evals.expected_output: Gathers and states what exists (text layer or not, BOM, models available, documents). Starts from the example with new_panel.mjs, proves build and audit, then replaces data in checklist order: wirelist.json transcribed with sheet and line numbers, layout.mjs, faces, makers' models fetched (asking before downloads, never doing CAPTCHAs or logins), model_fit with each orientation checked, terminals with sources, the panel-specific guide.js blocks. Audit clean, every device looked at, sheets re-read against the list by independent readers, design issues separated from modeling issues, handover documents written, and a plain statement of what was not verified (nothing checked against a built panel).

evals.prompt: In the VFD 200 guide, the assemblers want the mounting holes for CB4 (WAGO 787-1668) and for the drives shown on their part pages. Add them as a new version.
evals.expected_output: A new version made with scripts/new_version.mjs. The drives already carry their documented pattern (116.0 x 247.0 mm, M5, 520-UM001 p.188 and p.15): nothing is invented for where it sits in the outline. CB4 is a DIN-rail part with no mounting holes and no hole document: no HOLES entry is added and nothing is shown or estimated for it; the answer says so and says what document would be needed. Any number added is printed in a cited document that was opened. The build and audit are run and their numbers reported.
